en-US.name: BuildIso
en-US.releaseNotes:
BuildIso 2027.2 — Release Notes

Overview
BuildIso 2027.2 introduces a pipeline-driven ISO creation workflow with BIOS and UEFI boot support, file inventory and validation, SHA-256 integrity checks, ISO inspection and verification, optional QEMU boot testing, plugin management, and structured reporting.
This release also expands command-line controls, configuration profiles, preflight diagnostics, and output handling.

1. ISO Creation and Boot Support
- Added support for BIOS-only, UEFI-only, and hybrid BIOS + UEFI configurations.
- Added multi-entry El Torito boot catalog generation for hybrid BIOS/UEFI images.
- Added configurable El Torito boot entry priority through --boot-priority (bios, uefi, or auto).
- Added BIOS boot image validation and EFI System Partition image checks.
- Added checks for the presence of EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI in the ISO source directory.
- Added Secure Boot-related PE inspection, including Authenticode signature presence and target architecture checks.
- Added Joliet filesystem support for ISO creation and verification.

2. File Inventory and Scanning
- Added centralized file inventory management through FileInventory and FileTreeScanner.
- Added repeatable file inclusion and exclusion filters with --include and --exclude.
- Added glob pattern matching through GlobMatcher.
- Added symbolic-link and reparse-point handling during file scanning.
- Added ISO path sanitization and configurable name-collision handling through --collision-policy (rename, fail, or skip).
- Added configurable scanning and size limits:
  - --max-files — maximum number of files to scan.
  - --max-file-size — maximum permitted size for an individual file.
  - --max-depth — maximum directory traversal depth.
  - --max-size — maximum permitted ISO size.

3. SHA-256 Integrity and Hash Cache
- Added SHA-256 hashing for source files and generated ISO images.
- Added FileHasher and HashCache for file hashing and reuse of cached hashes.
- Added configurable hash cache location through --cache <file>, used by --deep-verify.
- Added --expect-sha256 <hex> to fail validation when the final ISO hash does not match the expected SHA-256 value.
- Added optional MANIFEST.SHA256SUMS generation, containing file paths, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.

4. ISO Inspection and Verification
- Added IsoTools.Inspect for displaying ISO information, directory and file counts, volume details, and boot catalog entries.
- Added IsoTools.Verify and IsoVerifier for ISO structure and boot catalog verification, including manifest checks when a manifest is available.
- Added --inspect <iso> to inspect an existing ISO.
- Added --verify-iso <iso> to verify an existing ISO and its manifest, if present.
- Added --deep-verify to re-read files from the ISO and compare their contents with the corresponding source files.
- Added --check to run diagnostics without building an ISO.
- Added --dry-run to simulate the ISO layout without writing the final image.
- Added --strict to treat warnings as build failures.
- Added safe preflight remediation through --fix-safe. Its automatic fixes are limited to creating a missing output directory and removing a stale temporary ISO file.

5. QEMU and UEFI Boot Testing
- Added optional ISO boot smoke testing through QEMU with --boot-test.
- Added custom QEMU executable selection through --qemu <path>.
- Added OVMF firmware selection through --ovmf <path> for UEFI boot testing.
- Added a configurable virtual-machine test timeout through --boot-test-timeout.

6. Build Pipeline and Output Handling
- Added a structured BuildPipeline with the following stages:
  1.  StepPreflight
  2.  StepScanFiles
  3.  StepValidateBoot
  4.  StepPredictSize
  5.  StepCheckDiskSpace
  6.  StepBuildIso
  7.  StepVerifyIso
  8.  StepBootTest
  9.  StepWriteManifest
  10. StepWriteReadme
  11. StepFinalize
- Added preflight diagnostics for output paths, directory permissions, temporary files, boot configuration, and other build requirements.
- Added output locking through OutputLockHandle.
- Added temporary ISO generation and output replacement handling.
- Added rollback support through IsoBuilderService.Rollback().
- Added --timeout <seconds> to limit the overall build duration.
- Added --no-overwrite to prevent replacement of an existing output ISO.
- Added --keep-backup to retain the previous ISO as a .bak file after a successful build.
- Added reproducible-build support through --reproducible, including ISO timestamp normalization.
- Added --source-date-epoch <seconds> to specify the timestamp used by reproducible-build mode.

7. Configuration and Build Profiles
- Added JSON configuration loading through ConfigFileLoader and --config <file>.
- Added named configuration profiles through --profile:
  - development — enables verbose output.
  - release — enables manifest generation, deep verification, strict mode, and required plugin hash pins.
  - reproducible — enables reproducible-build mode, manifest generation, deep verification, and disables plugins.
  - ci — disables interactive prompts, spinner, and progress indicators, and enables manifest generation and strict mode.
- Added option validation and merging across command-line arguments, JSON configuration, and profile defaults.

8. Plugin System
- Added the IBuildPlugin interface with build lifecycle and pipeline-step callbacks.
- Added plugin discovery, loading, and management through PluginManager.
- Added plugin selection through --plugin <name> and global plugin disabling through --plugins-off.
- Added SHA-256 plugin hash pinning through --plugin-hash <name>=<sha256>.
- Added --require-plugin-hash to refuse plugins without a configured hash pin.
- Added --plugin-strict to fail the build when a plugin callback fails.
- Added configurable per-callback timeouts through --plugin-timeout <seconds>.

9. Reports, Manifest, and Build Documentation
- Added build report output in JSON, JUnit, and SARIF formats through --report-format.
- Added report file path configuration through --json-report <file>.
- Added optional MANIFEST.SHA256SUMS generation through --manifest.
- Added automatic build documentation generation through ReadmeGenerator, producing README_BUILDISO.txt in the ISO output directory during the normal build pipeline.
- Added structured build reports through BuildReportWriter, including build status, timing, file counts, ISO size, SHA-256 information, profile, and configuration details.

10. Additional Command-Line Controls
- Added configurable hashing parallelism through --threads.
- Added custom log file selection through --log <file> and logging disablement through --no-log.
- Added output and interaction controls:
  - --silent
  - --verbose
  - --no-prompt
  - --no-spinner
  - --no-progress
- Added dedicated exit codes for success, general errors, invalid arguments, preflight failures, validation failures, cancellation, and boot-test failures.
BuildIso 2027.2 brings ISO creation, boot configuration, file scanning, integrity verification, automation, plugin support, and reporting together in a single pipeline-driven command-line application.
Implementation note: Secure Boot-related checks inspect PE validity, Authenticode signature presence, and target architecture. They should not be interpreted as complete cryptographic certificate-chain or firmware trust validation.
